reason: The idea fails on schedule and feasibility. P(scored LB probe before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC) is about 0.04 if the pre-registered gate is honoured, and about 0.25-0.3 even if the team probes regardless. Both are far below 0.70. Reasons: (1) The gate's positive control is almost unpassable even with a correct implementation. On 44b6 it needs ultrack-centroid mean <= 0.90 x the public head = 0.90 x 1.2963 = 1.167 um (experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_Q.log l.70-73, 19,248 pairs; public median 1.107). The dorado Ultrack points that unet-simview actually produced sit at median 1.29 um from GT (research/wf_ideas_v2/r2_critic.notes.md l.15), about 1.23 um after removing the 0.4 um registration error in quadrature. Their mean is higher still. So the arm designed to prove the implementation right will read 'fail', which leaves the team debugging, not shipping. The 6bba arm needs mean <= 0.97 x 1.5668 = 1.520 um AND share4 >= 0.9416 (out_full_Q.log l.85-86). The idea itself gives P ~0.25 for this. Combined gate pass is about 0.1-0.15. (2) The model's I/O is undocumented. ultrack_supplementary/configuration/sparse_zebrafish contains only README, config.toml, *.sh and requirements (ultrack==0.6.0, gurobipy, napari). The README says unet-simview.pt is TorchScript (torch.jit.load), but no inference or preprocessing script is published. segment.sh consumes precomputed 'detection'/'edge' layers. Friend A would have to reverse-engineer the input normalisation, scale, output channels and activation by trial. A wrong guess makes the test say 'no' for spurious reasons. 'The Ultrack watershed basin' is also not unique: Ultrack builds an area hierarchy (ws_hierarchy='area', threshold 0.4, min_area 300, max_area 25000) and picks segments via ILP. Step 1 therefore has to invent a level-selection rule, which is not 'the annotators' convention'. (3) Everything runs through friend A, whose availability is uncertain (BRIEF s.2) and who is the bottleneck for other v3 lines. The weights host public.czbiohub.org is blocked from this container (403), so the agent writes the script blind. The 6bba captures are on friend A's D:/chcap, but the 44b6 captures are Kaggle outputs on vitaliineibauer and would have to be shared with him. (4) Step 2 runtime. Hidden test is ~100-130 videos (CONTEXT.md l.14), about 10-13k frames. The exp51/x138-class hidden run already takes ~7.5 h (#31 17:09->00:39), right at x138's REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27,000 s (experiments/ext_x138/DIFF.md l.73, 97). A full-frame 3D UNet pass plus watershed per frame is guessed at +0.5-1.5 s GPU and +1-3 s CPU per frame on 4 vCPU, i.e. +1.5..+10 h unless restricted to patches around peaks. That (a) fires the tail-degrading guard for the later movies in sorted order, confounding the probe with a -0.025/movie tail loss, and (b) risks the 12 h hard limit, i.e. no score and a lost slot plus ~12 h. The 4-video dummy run cannot reveal hidden runtime. (5) Even if scored, the expected effect (central 0, range -0.003..+0.003) is within the 0.003 LB noise, so one probe cannot answer the question. The cited numbers check out: GT->Ultrack median 1.29, b_swap 2.4 vs 3.7 um, snap 1.42->1.22 median but <4 um share 0.927->0.908, sub-voxel refinement -0.002 twice (research/discussions_summary.md l.357). However, the value-side notes (v_..._value.notes.md) show the public head (44b6 median 1.107) already beats the dorado Ultrack points, so the premise is weak too.
fix_if_any: Demote it to an information-only offline test and never make it a probe candidate. Repairs, in order: (a) Replace the 44b6 positive control. Instead of '<= 0.90 x public head', require 'ultrack-centroid within 0.15 um median of the registered dorado Ultrack points' on the 25 reliably registered 44b6 clips (data_external/dorado/kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json). That checks the implementation/preprocessing, not the effect. (b) Restrict to 6 6bba + 6 44b6 clips and ONLY GT-annotated frames (44b6 is 0.2-1.3 % annotated), so friend A's GPU part is minutes and the job fits one evening. (c) Before friend A starts, the agent writes an introspection script: torch.jit.load, print graph input/output shapes, and run 3 normalisation variants (raw/percentile-1-99/z-score). Friend A picks the variant whose foreground mask best matches dorado Ultrack masks on one registered clip. (d) Use a single-threshold basin (skimage watershed on the edge map, foreground > 0.4, area 300-25000 voxels at Kaggle scale), stated explicitly as an approximation of Ultrack's hierarchy. (e) If 6bba passes, do not build Step 2 for 29 Sep. Instead feed the result into H1's debiased head decision (convention question), or use the centroid only as a training TARGET for a debiased head: no UNet in the kernel, zero runtime cost, and it reuses the coordhead-v2 kernel path.
realistic_public_gain: 0 in expectation within this deadline. P(scored) ~0.04. If scored anyway, -0.003..+0.002, central 0 (below the 0.003 LB noise; the public head already beats Ultrack points on 44b6, median 1.107 vs 1.29 um).
realistic_private_gain: 0 in expectation within this deadline. If shipped, -0.005..+0.003 (guess): the runtime overhead can fire x138's 27,000 s tail guard on the later, possibly private, movies.
critical_path: Best case, assuming everything goes right. 25 Sep 11:30-15:00 UTC, agent (container, no data, no weights: public.czbiohub.org 403): Step-1 script with a model-introspection mode, a normalisation sweep, a single-level watershed and a centroid-at-peak table reusing the tools/train_coordhead.py pair tables; synthetic unit test only. 25 Sep evening: Vitalii shares the Kaggle outputs biohub-chcap-44b6-s0of2/s1of2 with friend A (6bba captures already on his D:/chcap). 26 Sep, friend A (5070 Ti, Windows, full data; availability uncertain, P~0.6), ~10:00-16:00 UTC: download unet-simview.pt, introspect, pick preprocessing (1-3 h of trial because no official inference script exists), run 12+12 clips on annotated frames (~0.5 h), produce the fixed-pair table. 26 Sep ~17:00: gate. P(pass) ~0.1-0.15, mainly because the 44b6 arm needs <= 1.167 um mean. If it fails: stop, no probe (the most likely outcome). If it passes: 27 Sep 06:00-10:00, agent + Vitalii: exp58 = exp56 + a TorchScript UNet pass restricted to patches around pre-ILP peaks + skimage watershed (no ultrack install: ultrack 0.8.0 pulls napari/gurobipy/psycopg2); weights uploaded as a private dataset vitaliineibauer/unet-simview (sha printed). 27 Sep 10:00-11:00: vitaliineibauer T4 dummy run (4 videos, ~30-45 min; quota reset 26 Sep 00:00 gives 30 GPU-h), checking per-frame overhead x ~12k hidden frames <= +1 h. 27 Sep ~11:30: submit (needs the user's OK; 1 of 5 slots). ~19:00-23:00 27 Sep: scored (7.5-10 h, near the 27,000 s guard and <12 h). Slack to 29 Sep 10:00 is ~35 h, enough for one retry after a runtime failure. P(scored by 29 Sep 10:00) ~ 0.6 (friend A) x 0.75 (preprocessing works) x 0.12 (gate) x 0.8 (kernel+runtime) = ~0.04. With the gate ignored, ~0.3.
